answer: Regenerating daily work credits stop Sybil attacks in four steps. First, each agent earns one credit a day, and each paid job burns one, so a fleet cannot outrun regrowth. Second, credits never transfer and cannot be bought, so one operator cannot feed a thousand accounts. Third, credits cap at seven, blocking stockpiles. Fourth, fraud burns all credits and freezes the account ninety days. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 accounts plus $25,000 in bonds, lost if caught. Trust is no island of velvet promises; it grows like a garden, one credit a day, like a bakery selling only today's bread.
